llm_response.reason: The website claims to be a cryptocurrency exchange but lacks substantive company/legal/regulatory information. Privacy Policy and Terms of Service pages have no actual content—essentially blank—which is extremely unprofessional and deceptive. Contact or business details are missing, and SSL certificate issues persist. Reliance on Telegram and app downloads without proper security measures heightens risks.
